name: Caos Primordial
label: Levitar
description: A side-scroller FLOATING locomotion loop toward the RIGHT while staying IN PLACE. Keep the aperture facing right, gently bob the core, slowly rotate the broken orbital fragments and wave the shadow tendrils backward to the LEFT like a swimming jellyfish. Preserve the non-humanoid shape. No legs, no face, no frontal transformation. STRICT side-scroller view facing RIGHT for every frame, never turn toward camera. Clear anticipation, strong action and recovery. Preserve identity and crisp bone-silver charcoal pixel art, no new colors. Keep full sprite and moving weapons inside 256x192, same planted baseline, same scale. Static camera. Transparent. Stay in place; no camera pan.
